about: Observed-deck selector cases, shared by tests/test_observed.py (Python) and tests/web/run2_test.cjs (JavaScript). Expected results were worked out by hand from the rule: keep decks holding every seed card form; order by objective at 1e-10 precision, then deck key; keep a deck only if it differs from every earlier pick by at least min_diff card ids; stop at n_results. D and G tie with float noise (0.58 vs 0.5800000000000001), so key order decides. C and D hold the same card ids (Knight base vs evo), so they never both pass min_diff 2.
